reason: Current request-path foreign read-client inventory for Read-Path Independence. New entries indicate renewed cross-context fan-out and must be migrated to a local composite projection or explicitly justified.
classificationGuide: composite-projection-servable: default. Serve the route from a local view-owned projection fed by upstream events.
read-your-writes: the read follows the caller's own write; replace HTTP with a local mirror plus wake-before-wait (#2512).
genuinely-synchronous: only for reads that cannot be projected; requires a written justification.

m108 #4271: marketplace computes seller behavioral-metrics rates exactly once (the AC's 'compute once' requirement); this request-path call keeps that single computation authoritative for discovery's public-profile chip surface instead of duplicating the rolling-window SQL into a second discovery-owned projection. If discovery later needs the same chips at higher read volume/latency sensitivity, project only the pre-thresholded boolean chip facts (never the raw rates) into discovery's own market-account mirror, fed by a chips-changed event marketplace would need to start emitting.
